Bundled RPC helpers select SRSTACK_RPC_URL > ALCHEMY_API_KEY > the official public default. Optional Alchemy keys or custom HTTP/HTTPS endpoints, including path/query and Basic authentication, use host-managed environment secrets; HTTPS is preferred for credentials. Provider recommendations do not restrict endpoint selection, and there is no silent failover.

Keep credentials in approved host facilities, not prompts, command lines, output artifacts or installed skill files; endpoint evidence and diagnostics redact credentials. Do not bypass provider access controls or substitute saved observations for failed live reads.
